transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… I’ve just not been eating much lately. Last few weeks, food doesn’t really sound good, even stuff I usually grab after work. I’ll take a few bites and kind of have to force it.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?
Yeah… I guess I’ve been feeling pretty low most days. It’s like this heavy, flat feeling. Even when I’m at home or around people at work, I don’t really feel… there.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy levels or felt unusually tired lately, even after resting?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I haven’t really been paying close attention. I’m still getting through work and stuff.
Have you lost interest in activities or hobbies that you used to enjoy, like maybe things you did for fun before work got busy or before you started feeling this way?
Yeah… I guess so. I used to run in the mornings, play guitar a bit, cook dinner sometimes. Lately I just… don’t. It all feels like work, and I can’t really make myself care about it.
Have you found that you no longer get any pleasure or satisfaction from things you used to enjoy, like running, playing guitar, or cooking?

Yeah… pretty much. I used to actually look forward to running, or messing around on guitar, cooking something after work. Now I just skip it. It all feels like a chore, and I don’t really care enough to start.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two weeks or more?
Yeah… most days, I guess. It’s like this heavy, flat feeling that just kind of stays with me. Even at home or sitting around at work, I’m there, but not really… there.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or feeling physically slowed down?
Yeah… a little. At work, people have mentioned I’m kind of slow in briefings, and I take longer to answer. Feels like my body and my mouth are both… behind.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or blamed yourself for things more than usual lately?
I don’t know… not really more than usual, I guess. I mean, I get frustrated with myself, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been blaming myself a lot.
Have you found that you’ve completely stopped doing things you used to enjoy, like running or playing guitar, because they don’t interest you at all anymore?
Yeah… pretty much. I mean, I used to run in the mornings, play guitar sometimes, cook dinner… and lately I just skip it. It all feels like work, like chores. I can’t really get myself to care.
Have you completely lost interest in everything, like even things you used to really enjoy or look forward to?
Yeah… I mean, not everything maybe, but the stuff I used to look forward to. Running in the mornings, guitar, making dinner… I just keep skipping it. It feels like a chore now.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy levels or felt unusually tired lately, even after resting?
I’m not sure… I mean, I get tired, but I don’t know if it’s a big drop or anything. I haven’t really paid that much attention.
Have you felt unusually tired or noticed a significant drop in your energy levels almost every day, even when you haven’t been doing much?
I don’t know… almost every day sounds like a lot. I get tired sometimes, sure, but I haven’t really noticed it that clearly.
Would you say you've felt unusually tired or low on energy so often that it's noticeable, like most days even when you're not doing much?
I… I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed it being like most days. Maybe here and there, but I don’t think I could say it’s been that obvious.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight or appetite because of how you’ve been feeling lately?
Yeah… my appetite’s been off. For the last few weeks I just haven’t really wanted to eat much. Even stuff I usually like after work, I’ll kind of just sit there and force a few bites.
Has your decreased appetite led to any noticeable weight loss recently?
I haven’t really checked my weight, so I don’t know. I just know I’ve barely been eating… like after a shift, food I usually like just kind of sits there and I force a few bites.
Have you noticed any significant weight loss recently because you haven’t been eating much?

I don’t know if it’s been significant. I haven’t really weighed myself. I just know I haven’t had much appetite these last few weeks… even after work, stuff I usually like, I’m just forcing a few bites.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost a significant amount of weight recently, even if you haven’t been trying to?

I don’t really know about “significant.” I haven’t been trying to lose weight or anything… I just haven’t had much appetite. Food I usually like after work just kind of sits there, and I force a few bites.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost a noticeable amount of weight recently, even though you haven’t been trying to?
I’m not sure about the weight part. I haven’t really been checking. I just know I’ve barely had an appetite lately… even food I usually want after a shift, I’m just kind of forcing a few bites.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost a significant amount of weight recently because you haven’t been eating much?

I don’t know if I’d call it significant… I haven’t really checked my weight. I just haven’t been eating much. Last few weeks, even after work, stuff I usually like just sits there and I force down a few bites.
